file.origine: Generato con AI da Google (Veo): firma C2PA 'Created by Google Generative AI', watermark SynthID, creato partendo da un'immagine di input

concetto.formula: Scena elegante e lenta (6 s) -> incidente improvviso -> splash finale
perche_funziona: Contrasto: vestito elegante, yacht, sera -> finisce in acqua
Attesa: 5 secondi di discesa lenta, si capisce che sta per succedere qualcosa
Tre inquadrature come un film: campo lungo, primo piano dell'urlo, splash dall'alto
Audio forte nel momento giusto: urla + splash

bibbia_visiva.personaggio_en: a curvy woman in her early 30s with long wavy ombre hair (dark brown roots, honey-blonde lengths), wearing a long-sleeved blush-pink satin wrap midi dress with a tie at the hip and a deep V neckline, a thin gold necklace and bracelet, and nude pointed high heels
bibbia_visiva.barca_en: a white 15-meter motor yacht with a flybridge, stainless steel railings, a life ring and a small red flag on top, a warm-lit teak cockpit and wooden cabin interior, the name "CALA MAYOR" in blue capital letters on the stern, white fenders, and a green-carpeted gangway with stainless handrails leading down to a concrete floating pontoon
bibbia_visiva.luogo_en: a Mediterranean marina at night, rows of moored motor yachts and sailboats, lamp posts, dark green still water with light reflections
bibbia_visiva.stile_en: Muted cinematic color grade, cool teal-green shadows, warm practical lights, soft contrast, slight film grain, shot on a cinema camera, 24 fps.
bibbia_visiva.luce: notte, luci calde della cabina, lampioni freddi sullo sfondo

inquadrature.inquadratura: campo lungo, altezza occhi (~1,6 m), camera sul pontile a 8-10 m dalla poppa, leggermente a destra dell'asse della passerella, obiettivo ~35 mm

azione.cosa: Esce dalla porta della cabina illuminata e appoggia la mano sinistra al corrimano
Scende la passerella verde a piccoli passi sui tacchi, guardando i piedi
Arriva in fondo e mette il piede sul bordo del pontile
Il tacco si impunta, perde l'equilibrio verso l'acqua (a destra), braccia aperte, bocca aperta

inquadrature.prompt_en: A Mediterranean marina at night, rows of moored motor yachts and sailboats, lamp posts, dark green still water with light reflections. Eye-level wide shot from the concrete pontoon facing the stern of a white 15-meter motor yacht with a flybridge, stainless steel railings, a life ring and a small red flag on top, a warm-lit teak cockpit and wooden cabin interior, the name "CALA MAYOR" in blue capital letters on the stern, white fenders, and a green-carpeted gangway with stainless handrails leading down to a concrete floating pontoon. A curvy woman in her early 30s with long wavy ombre hair (dark brown roots, honey-blonde lengths), wearing a long-sleeved blush-pink satin wrap midi dress with a tie at the hip and a deep V neckline, a thin gold necklace and bracelet, and nude pointed high heels walks out of the cabin and carefully down the gangway toward the camera, holding the railing and looking down at her steps. As she reaches the pontoon her heel catches on the edge, she wobbles and loses her balance toward the water, arms flailing, gasping "Oh!". The camera slowly pans right to follow her, accelerating slightly at the end. Sounds: quiet marina ambience, gentle water lapping, heels clicking on the metal gangway, her surprised gasp. No music. Muted cinematic color grade, cool teal-green shadows, warm practical lights, soft contrast, slight film grain, shot on a cinema camera, 24 fps.

inquadrature.inquadratura: piano americano (dalle cosce in su), camera a mano ad altezza petto, ~2,5 m da lei; poppa a sinistra, acqua e barche a destra

azione.cosa: Sul bordo del pontile stringe il corrimano con la destra, braccio sinistro teso, occhi sgranati, urla
Cade dal bordo, braccia in alto, gambe in aria, vestito che si solleva

audio.voce: due urla 'Aaah!' a 6,2-6,5 s e 6,6-7,0 s (forti, ~-18 dB)

inquadrature.prompt_en: Night, same marina. Handheld medium shot at chest height, very close to the same woman (a curvy woman in her early 30s with long wavy ombre hair (dark brown roots, honey-blonde lengths), wearing a long-sleeved blush-pink satin wrap midi dress with a tie at the hip and a deep V neckline, a thin gold necklace and bracelet, and nude pointed high heels) standing at the very edge of the pontoon next to the yacht's green gangway; the yacht stern is on the left, dark water and moored boats on the right. She clutches the stainless railing with one hand, the other arm stretched out, eyes wide and mouth open, screaming "Aaah!" as she tips backward toward the water. The camera quickly pans right and tilts down with a slight roll to follow her as she falls off the edge, legs kicking up, dress flaring. Sounds: two panicked screams, shoes scraping on concrete. No music. Muted cinematic color grade, cool teal-green shadows, warm practical lights, soft contrast, slight film grain, shot on a cinema camera, 24 fps.

inquadrature.inquadratura: campo lungo dall'alto (~3 m), dal bordo del pontile; angolo di cemento con bitta di ferro in basso a sinistra, pontile galleggiante in diagonale sullo sfondo con yacht e lampioni

azione.cosa: Entra in acqua in piedi/seduta, braccia alzate, capelli mossi (sfocatura di movimento)
Splash enorme, lame d'acqua a ventaglio, lei scompare
L'acqua si calma in un grande anello di schiuma; riemerge fino al petto, agita le braccia, bocca aperta

audio.effetti: splash fortissimo a 7,4 s, acqua che ribolle e si calma (da -20 a -40 dB)

inquadrature.prompt_en: Night, same marina. Wide high-angle shot from the edge of the concrete pontoon, an iron mooring bollard in the bottom-left foreground, a long floating dock running diagonally in the background with moored motor yachts and lamp posts. The same woman in the blush-pink wrap dress drops feet-first in a seated position with arms raised into the dark green water, creating a huge splash with sheets of water fanning out. The splash settles into a wide ring of white foam as she resurfaces up to her chest, gasping and splashing with her arms. Slow push-in with a slight pan right. Sounds: a loud splash, churning water, her gasping. No music. Muted cinematic color grade, cool teal-green shadows, warm practical lights, soft contrast, slight film grain, shot on a cinema camera, 24 fps.

prompt_negativo_en: text, subtitles, captions, music, watermark, logo, extra people, distorted hands, deformed face, cartoon, CGI look

come_rifarlo_identico.strumento: Google Flow (Veo) -> 'Frames to Video', oppure app Gemini -> video da foto
passi: Per ogni inquadratura carica fotogramma_inizio come primo fotogramma (e fotogramma_fine come ultimo, se lo strumento lo permette)
Genera 3-4 versioni per inquadratura e scegli la più simile
Taglia: shot 1 = 6,000 s, shot 2 = 1,417 s, shot 3 = 2,583 s
come_rifarlo_identico.per_mettere_un_altro_volto: modifica prima i 6 fotogrammi di riferimento con il nuovo volto (es. modifica immagine in Gemini) e poi usa quelli; solo con il tuo volto o con il consenso della persona

dati_per_fotogramma.legenda: dx/dy = spostamento immagine in px su 1280x720 rispetto al fotogramma prima (dx<0: camera va a destra; dy<0: camera scende), scale>1 = avvicinamento
